_comment: Four Forests and a Wild Growth give five mana. Greaves and Elf spend three; hasted Elf untaps the enchanted Forest to pay for Satyr, then Greaves moves to Satyr and its untap pays for Nylea. The nine-mana line needs both equip activations in one main phase.
